mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_student_organization (id, student_id, organization_id, relation_type, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{organizationId}, 'ENROLLMENT', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = #{classOrganizationId} AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND target_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND target_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.class_organization_id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT DISTINCT student.id FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id AND related_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND related_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND target_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND target_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student.id

SELECT DISTINCT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student.grade_code, enrollment.organization_id AS enrollment_organization_id, enrollment_organization.organization_name AS enrollment_organization_name, student_class.organization_id AS current_class_organization_id, class_organization.organization_name AS current_class_organization_name FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.student_id = student.id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_class.organization_id WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT class_organization.id, class_organization.organization_name AS name FROM sys_organization class_organization JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE class_organization.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY class_organization.organization_name, class_organization.id
